summary: A specialist orthodontic studio with a 5.0 Google rating and Invisalign focus is a strength, but unclear fees and mixed names appear to cost you consultations.

findings.problem: The Invisalign consultation appears labelled free but requires a 30 pound deposit, and a 95 pound children's consultation fee appears next to a From 95 pounds monthly plan.
findings.cost: Unclear fees confuse patients and cost bookings.

findings.problem: The practice appears named West London Orthodontics in the FAQ and West London Orthodontist elsewhere, and the award title appears in two versions.
findings.cost: Mixed names and titles weaken a premium brand.
findings.fix: One brand name and one verified award title.

findings.problem: The email address appears only as an obfuscated placeholder, and a second address at 23 Harley Street appears in the footer with no explanation.
findings.cost: Patients cannot tell where to go or how to write to you.
findings.fix: A readable contact email and one clear locations page.

findings.problem: The text 'Swipe to watch' appears with only one written testimonial, the practice tour film appears with no player, and the footer appears to show 'Last updated 30 October 2026'.
findings.cost: Missing media and odd dates make the site look unfinished.

redesign: One brand name and verified award.
A readable email, clear locations, working video and reviews.
